criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.2-4. Six procedure groups, each its own lettered A-G list under 'ALL of the following are met', then an aesthetic exclusion list. The OTHER section (p.5) adds the content a referral letter may include.
procedures_covered: Aesthetic/cosmetic procedures: not covered (blepharoplasty, face lift, liposuction, rhinoplasty, voice modification surgery, etc.)

logic.top_level: pathways: one procedure group per paragraph, each 'meets the definition of medical necessity when ALL of the following are met' (A-G)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline as criteria: 'D. No medical contraindications to surgery'; 'E. Any mental health concerns are well controlled'. Separate list of aesthetic procedures that 'do not meet the definition of medical necessity when performed as part of gender affirmation surgery (the list is not all-inclusive)'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No revision or repeat criteria. The pre-op requirement differs by group: 12 months of hormones for genital and gonadal surgery, but 'Hormone therapy is not a pre-requisite' for mastectomy/chest surgery; breast augmentation requires hormones for 12 months but only one referral letter.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: F. Documentation of 12 continuous months of hormone therapy (unless the member has a medical contraindication or is otherwise unable to take hormones); AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The AND is placed after F; G follows. 'otherwise unable' is an open exception clause.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: E. Any mental health concerns are well controlled; AND F. One referral letter from a licensed mental health professional. (Note: Hormone therapy is not a pre-requisite.)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The 'AND' appears at different lines in different groups (after E here, after F elsewhere): lettered lists are an ALL, the AND tokens are redundant noise.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The following procedures are considered aesthetic (cosmetic) and do not meet the definition of medical necessity when performed as part of gender affirmation surgery (the list is not all-inclusive)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Open-ended list; surgeries not named are undecided.

requirement_kinds.quote: A. Member is 18 years or older
B. Member has the capacity to make a fully informed decision and to consent for treatment
C. Documentation shows persistent and well documented gender dysphoria
D. No medical contraindications to surgery
E. Any mental health concerns are well controlled
Documentation of 12 continuous months of hormone therapy
Letter of assessment from a health care professional who has competencies in the assessment of transgender and gender diverse people.
requirement_kinds.where: G (genital surgery groups) vs 'One referral letter from a licensed mental health professional' (chest groups)

time_windows.quote: Documentation of 12 continuous months of hormone therapy

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: No. CPT 55970/55980 and 25 component procedure codes (mastectomy, orchiectomy, hysterectomy, vaginoplasty codes) 'may be billed separately'; ICD-10 F64.0-F64.9 and Z87.8901-Z87.893. Not mapped to procedure groups. The update log says 'Z89.8901 - Z87.893 added' while the table prints 'Z87.8901- Z87.893'.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: marked incongruence between one’s experienced/expressed gender and their assigned gender, lasting at least 6 months, as manifested by at least two of the following

vague_terms.quote: persistent and well documented gender dysphoria
vague_terms.problem: 'persistent' undefined (Description gives 6 months and DSM two-of-six, but the Position Statement does not reference it).

vague_terms.quote: Any mental health concerns are well controlled
vague_terms.problem: no measure or evidence type; 'well controlled' judged by reviewer.

vague_terms.quote: competencies in the assessment of transgender and gender diverse people

extraction_hazards: Lettered criteria A-G are plain indented lines (no bullet glyph), identical across six paragraphs; a parser must carry the heading sentence ('Hysterectomy and ovariectomy ... meets the definition ...') to each block.

Headings of the six procedure groups are ordinary sentences in the same typeface as body text, so group boundaries must be found by the phrase 'meets the definition of medical necessity when ALL of the following are met'.
A stray single word 'Other' sits on its own line before the aesthetic exclusion list.
The Position Statement heading line is followed by the NOTE, which carries a benefits caveat.
Dates: the update log has a duplicated 03/15/24 entry and entries dated after the 'Reviewed' date (03/15/26, 10/01/26).
interesting_structures: Same seven-line criteria template instantiated per procedure with small deltas (hormones required or not; one letter vs assessment letter).
Differences are the whole logic: which procedures need 12 months of hormones, which need a 'referral letter' vs 'letter of assessment'.
The Description contains a diagnostic definition (DSM-5-TR) that the criteria 'persistent and well documented gender dysphoria' silently relies on.
OTHER section lists what a referral letter should contain (5 items), a documentation checklist outside the criteria.

fit_to_tree.why: six clean all-of lists, one per procedure; leaves are documentation checks. Strain: 'well controlled', 'persistent', and the hormone exemption clause; the per-group variants invite a shared-leaves-with-overrides design.
